title: 71/ND/2019 — Lalit Chatnani LAlit Shatnani vs. SPE Films India Pvt Ltd & Anr New Delhi Disposed View Order ...
text:
NATIONAL COMPANY LAW APPELLATE TRIBUNAL, NEW DELHI
I.A. No. 275 of 2019
In
Company Appeal(AT)(Insolvency) No. 71 of 2019
IN THE MATTER OF:
Lalit Chatnani …Appellant
Vs
SPE Films India Pvt. Ltd. ….Respondents
Through its Interim Resolution Professional
Mr. Aditya Agrawal & Anr.
Present:
For Appellant: Mr. Abhishek Malhotra and Ms. Shilpa Gamnani,
Advocates
For Respondents:
O R D E R
04.02.2019 Mr. Abhishek Malhotra, learned Counsel appearing on behalf
of Appellant/Applicant submits that the parties have settled the matter and
thereby sought permission to withdraw the appeal.
In view of such stand taken by the learned Counsel for the
Appellant/Applicant and submissions made in I.A. No. 275 of 2019, the appeal
is disposed of as withdrawn but without any liberty to challenge the same very
order.
I.A. No. 275 of 2019 also stands withdrawn.
[Justice S.J. Mukhopadhaya]
Chairperson
[Justice Bansi Lal Bhat]
Member (Judicial)
